newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia helps Helsinki to stronger pre-holiday close.
newsitem.headline: Nokia helps Helsinki to stronger pre-holiday close.

text.p: Finnish shares closed slightly higher on Friday ahead of the long midsummer weekend, boosted in late trade by U.S. economic data and by a firmer opening on Wall Street for telecoms blue-chip Nokia's ADR, brokers said.
Building on Wednesday's cautious gains, the FOX stock futures index ended 0.19 percent higher at 1,070.39 and the HEX all-share index advanced 0.42 percent to 3,126.39.
But for the week, which saw the central bank warn of accelerating inflation, the leading indices closed 0.5-0.9 percent down.
Friday's turnover was moderately active at 500 million markka.

With most domestic investors absent due to summer holidays, operators said shares would drift without clear direction at least until the U.S. Federal Reserve's (central bank) July 1-2 meeting on key interest rates on July 1-2.
Nokia closed 3.00 markka higher at 365.00 markka while UPM-Kymmene, Europe's biggest forest industry group, eased 0.10 markka to 120.80 markka.
The Helsinki stock exchange will be closed on Friday and reopen on Monday, June 23.
